# A computer built for you AI.

A place to work. A way to learn.

Your agents work with your tools and keep the context that matters. They can propose changes to their skills, instructions, and memory. You decide what carries into the next task.

### Projects

Each project is a repo your agents run from — scaffolded with beeuni init, deployed with beeuni ship.

## Your agent doesn't start over.

Its skills, instructions, and memory live as files you can inspect. After a task, the agent can propose what to change. You review it, keep what works, and the next task starts from there.

### A skill for every job

The steps you want your agent to follow, written once and ready for the next task.

### Context that stays with the agent

Skills and memory live alongside the agent, where you can inspect and edit them.

### See what changed

Review an agent's proposed changes before they become part of how it works.

### Make the next run better

An agent can revise how it works based on a completed task. You review the change before it becomes part of the project. That's recursive self-improvement with an approval step.

## From a task to a better next run.

Connect your tools, ask for the outcome, and review what comes back. Keep the skills and context that help your agent do the next task better.

### Connect your tools once.

Connect the tools your agent needs, with access scoped to the work it does.

- 3,000+ apps, plus MCP, OpenAPI, GraphQL, and HTTP

- Credentials stay brokered by Beeuni, never copied into a session

- Scope each tool per project, per agent, per person

- Admins set what can run, what asks first, and what stays blocked

### Models

Bring any provider — routed per session, keys stay in Secrets

### Ask for the outcome.

Describe what you need in plain language — from Slack, Teams, the web, or your phone.

- No prompt-engineering course before the first useful task

- Ask for a report, brief, dashboard, reply, app, or change

- Every surface starts the same underlying kind of work

- Follow-up messages keep the context instead of starting over

### It works in a safe sandbox.

Each task runs in its own isolated machine with scoped permissions, its own files, and a full audit trail.

- Every session gets its own isolated sandbox and branch

- Agents use connected tools without ever holding raw keys

- Long-running work keeps going after you close the tab

- Every important action stays logged, reviewable, or approval-gated

### Review what comes back.

Beeuni returns finished work — a report, deck, dashboard, app, reply, or a change request you approve.

- People stay in control before anything important ships

- Files, diffs, and results open right in the workspace

- Change requests make every edit auditable before it reaches main

- Approved changes can become part of the project

### Review

See what went in and what came back before you keep it

Draft the Monday revenue brief

Stripe · HubSpot · Linear

MRR, pipeline, and blockers in one doc — ready to share.

### Save the workflow as a skill.

Turn a useful way of working into a skill file your agent can use again.

- Capture repeatable know-how in simple files

- Attach skills to the agents that need them

- Improve them through the same reviewable change flow

- Keep the steps that made this task work

### Keep what it learns.

Useful context and approved changes can carry into later sessions, so your agent does not have to start from zero.

- Relevant projects, people, and decisions carry forward

- Agents stop asking the same setup questions twice

- Memory stays inspectable as files

- You choose what carries into the next run

### Memory

Context Beeuni learned from your tools, files, and past sessions

Reused across sessions — every coworker starts from what the team already knows.

## Install Beeuni from your terminal.

One curl installs the CLI. From there you can create a project, launch sessions, and attach your local OpenCode TUI to any Beeuni sandbox.

Install the CLI

Copy, paste, and start locally.

## One request. Parallel work. A better next run.

Each task runs in an isolated session on its own branch. Agents can work in parallel and propose lasting changes through a change request. You review what becomes part of the project.

### Isolated & parallel

Thousands of sessions at once, each walled off in its own microVM sandbox.

### Real work, not chat

Agents act on real machines and return finished deliverables, not a paragraph.

### Reviewed into main

Durable changes land only through an approved change request you can diff.

### Compounds over time

Approved changes to skills and memory are there for the next task.

## Why does your agent start over every time?

### The task gets done

Your agent works with your tools, follows your instructions, and delivers a result.

### The lesson gets lost

Without a change to its skills or memory, you have to explain the same context again.

Beeuni lets your agent propose improvements after the work. Review them once, and the next task starts with what you kept.

## Give your agent a way to learn your work.

Start with one task. Keep the skills and context that help, and let your agent use them the next time.

Cloud agents that work across your tools.
